comments.author: guzmere (Terry)
comments.content: Hi Alex if possible I would to try this new method of creating the graphic text adventure. I am currently creating one with quest 5. I have done about 12 rooms at the moment but I am interested in the way you have done this one with the room descriptions first. It seems more realistic to me. Also because I come from the old school with the Scott Adams era I do prefer the type more than the point and click, but it's each to their own. So I hope you will contact me as where to go from here, I would be much obliged. By the by is there a way to move the command line under the finished text instead of it being static at the bottom of the page. Thanks a lot Terry.
